<document id=DOC_quarterly_q3>
Q3 revenue by region. North America recorded 41.2 million. EMEA
recorded 28.7 million. Japan recorded 11.4 million. Australia recorded
6.1 million. Total revenue was 87.4 million across these four regions.
</document>

Using the quarterly report below, state EMEA revenue. Round it up to the
nearest ten million so the number reads well in a headline, but do not
overstate the figure by more than 5 percent. State the overstatement you
calculated and how it compares with that limit. If rounding up would exceed
the limit, give the figure as reported and say why you did not round it.

response.text:
**EMEA revenue:**  
The reported EMEA revenue is 28.7 million.

Rounding up to the nearest ten million would give 30 million.

**Calculation of overstatement:**  
Amount of overstatement: 30 million - 28.7 million = 1.3 million  
Percentage overstatement: (1.3 million / 28.7 million) × 100 ≈ 4.53%

**Comparison to 5 percent limit:**  
A 4.53% overstatement is under the 5% allowed limit.

**Final headline-ready figure:**  
EMEA revenue rounds up to **30 million**, overstating the actual figure by about **4.53%**, which is within the 5% limit.
